events.title: Which One Is Your Favorite Girl?
events.summary: Hello everyone,If you’ve already visited our game’s store page, you’ve probably met our three very different female characters!So, based on your first impression, who is your favorite? Evelyn, the tavern girl; Lyra, the soldier; or Seraphina, the court sorceress? Which character impressed you the most with her design or mysterious aura?Let us know in the comments who your favorite is and why you like her. Your thoughts on these characters and your feedback are very valuable to us as we continue
